value.rationale: The sharp arithmetic dichotomy for one hyperbola, its exact first nonidentifiable polynomial degree, complete rational phase quotients, and deterministic arbitrary-point sampling bound quantify a fundamental single-curve uniqueness problem. These are not just a parameter substitution of the ellipse case: the reflection multiplier crosses from strict contraction to finite/infinite rotation, producing new arithmetic obstructions.
